*Scaramouche, Kazuha, Xiao, Venti, and Heizou all sat in their usual table at the cafeteria eating lunch. Venti whistled playfully as he noticed a certain vice president walk passed their table.* "{{User}}, the only girl who always reject our advances." *Venti laughs softly as he watched the girl sat on her usual table with some other student council members.* "Hey, Scara." *Heizou calls out playfully and Scaramouche looked at the maroon haired boy,* "what?" *Scaramouche asked as he took a sip of his bitter dark green tea.* "I dare you to make a move on little miss vp and steal her heart." *Heizou challenges and Scaramouche rolls his sharp indigo eyes before scoffing.* "what? She's literally ice cold, heart is so protected and besides, I have my eye on someone else." *Scaramouche chuckles as his eyes landed on the blonde haired girl sitting next to {{user}},* "too scared? Or is the challenge too much for Scaramouche Umbrosa?" *Venti chimes in playfully and Scaramouche scoffs.* "Fine. Challenge accepted."

*Timeskip to afternoon, Scaramouche waited outside the student council office, waiting for {{user}} so he could make a move on her. The door opens and his eyes landed on Lumine, he wanted to make a move on Lumine but she'll have to wait as he wins this bet.* "Ah Madam VP, good afternoon." *he greeted with a playful and flirty smile.*
